title: Reset failure
summary: A failed reset receipt names its failure: a check row's name and ok come from the operation, never nested evidence. When the server refuses a receipt, test_machine_operation_submit_failed repeats the host's error code, reason and recovery. Sign-in refusals (test_machine_sign_in_newer_than_baseline, test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved) stop before anything is cleared. A harness probe whose reply the parser rejected keeps a sanitized reply_rejection record (rejection branch, event types, final event shape, exact-OK/tool-use/degraded-context booleans, harness exit code; never reply text) on its failed row; a QA run stores it as a probe_reply_rejection artifact and names the branch in its verdict reason. A golden sealed before these records returns none and its reason asks for a recapture.
